issues.legal_issue: A settlement made after an assignee fulfilled the conditions of a government land assignment may create separate interests for compensation purposes when the assignment’s restriction on alienation had ended and the government recognized the transferees’ rights.
material_facts: The government assignment agreement restricted alienation until the amounts due for the land were paid.
The assignee paid the amounts due before executing a settlement distributing the land among his children.
The government recognized the settlement by mutating its records and issuing pattas to the children.
The proceedings concerned whether the surrendered land was one unit belonging to the assignee or separate units belonging to the children for compensation purposes.
issues.conclusion: The settlement was effective to create separate units for compensation purposes. Section 8 did not invalidate it because the restriction on alienation applied only until the amounts due had been paid, and the government had recognized the children’s rights by issuing pattas in their favour. The appeals were dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 8 of the Kerala Government Land Assignment Act, 1960, makes restrictions and conditions in a patta or other document evidencing an assignment of government land effective according to their terms, notwithstanding contrary law or usage. The restriction in the assignment agreement operated only until the amounts due to the government were paid; once they had been paid, that restriction did not prevent the later settlement. The government’s subsequent mutation of records and issuance of pattas to the transferees confirmed that no continuing assignment condition barred their rights. No earlier cases are relied on.

predicates.compensation_unit_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal about whether transferred government-assigned land constitutes one or multiple units for compensation after surrender.
predicates.assignment_restricts_transfer_only_until: The assignment document restricts transfer only while amounts due for the land remain unpaid.
predicates.assignee_paid_assignment_amounts_before_: The assignee paid the amounts due for the land before transferring interests in it.
predicates.government_recognized_transferees: The government recognized the transferees’ interests in its records or by issuing assignment documents to them.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns compensation units, the assignment restricts transfer only until payment, payment precedes the transfer, and the government recognizes the transferees, the transferees have separate compensation units.
